note: Fuzzer bytes are reinterpreted as the input string that drives bidi type classification.
The paragraph run list is compacted before later passes, so any stale links created here can be reused by subsequent merges.
Adjacent runs are merged whenever their type and level match, but the code does not ensure the predecessor/successor links remain safe for all list states before calling the destructive merge.
The merge writes through second->next after second has been selected for removal; if the list links are already stale, this becomes a heap-use-after-free write.
